test_title: PYST 64: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 07 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Five people, K, L, M, N, and O are sitting in a straight row, facing north. L is sitting on the immediate left of N. M is sitting on the immediate left of L. N is sitting on the immediate left of O. K is sitting on the extreme right end of the row. Who is sitting in the exact middle of the row?
solution:
Given: Five people, K, L, M, N, and O are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

K is sitting on the extreme right end of the row.

M is sitting on the immediate left of L

L is sitting on the immediate left of N. .

N is sitting on the immediate left of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a5ad60c0fd0bca0e1a37a8fed5f0c93498ed6905fc086470b4fff4da7bff188.png] 

Here, N is sitting in the exact middle of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
